get.description: Report whether the API is up and can reach the database.

delete.description: Deletes the module with all its topics, assessments, tasks and materials.

get.description: The module's topics as a nested tree, siblings in position order.

schema.title: Response Get Topic Tree Modules  Module Id  Topics Get

delete.description: Deletes the topic and all its subtopics.

get.description:
Your assessments across all modules, soonest first (undated last).

Repeat ``status`` to keep only those statuses, e.g. ``?status=upcoming``.
The module's assessments, soonest first (undated last).

schema.title: Response List Module Assessments Modules  Module Id  Assessments Get

patch.description: Change the fields sent; ``topic_ids`` replaces the whole set ([] clears it).

delete.description: Deletes the assessment; its tasks are kept, unlinked.

get.description:
Your tasks across all modules, soonest due first (undated last).

Repeat ``status`` to keep only those statuses, e.g. ``?status=todo&status=in_progress``.
The module's tasks, soonest due first (undated last).

schema.title: Response List Module Tasks Modules  Module Id  Tasks Get

patch.description: Setting status to "done" records completed_at; any other status clears it.

post.description:
Open a session with its start event (201).

Resending the same start event returns the existing session (200). Only one
session can be open at a time (409).

get.description: Your open session with its events (to resume the timer after a reload), or null.

schema.title: Response Get Active Session Sessions Active Get

post.description:
Add timer events, in any order. Already-stored ids are skipped if unchanged (409 if not).

The whole log is replayed: an impossible sequence (e.g. resume while active) is a
422 and nothing in the batch is saved.

put.description: Save the end-of-session reflection, replacing any earlier one (ended sessions only).

get.description: A page of the module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.
Measured study time for the module: all time, and since `week_start` (your local week).

post.description:
Upload one file (at most 50 MB) to the module and queue it for processing.

The same file twice in one module is a 409; a wrong type is a 415.

schema.title: Response List Materials Modules  Module Id  Materials Get

patch.description: Change the title, the kind or whether AI may process it.

delete.description: Delete the material (its file too, unless another of your modules has the same file).

post.description: Queue a failed material for processing again.

file.title: File
file.description: PDF, PPTX, DOCX, MD, TXT, PNG or JPG

EventBatch.title: EventBatch
EventBatch.description: Events to add, in any order. Ids already stored are skipped if unchanged.

retrying.title: Retrying
retrying.description: A failed attempt is waiting to be retried (`error` says why it failed).

ModuleSessionSummary.title: ModuleSessionSummary
ModuleSessionSummary.description: Measured study time for a module (active time only; breaks aren't study time).

SessionDetailOut.title: SessionDetailOut
SessionDetailOut.description: A session with its events in timeline order, for resuming the timer.

SessionPage.title: SessionPage
SessionPage.description: One page of a module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.

TopicMove.title: TopicMove
TopicMove.description: Move a topic under ``parent_id`` (null = top level) at index ``position``.

TopicNodeOut.title: TopicNodeOut
TopicNodeOut.description: A topic with its subtopics, for rendering the tree.
